title: Committee of Supply – Head O (Ministry of Health)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head O (Ministry of Health)

sections.label: Healthcare 2020 Masterplan progress update
sections.summary: A motion to cut Head O by $100 opens a request for an update on the Healthcare 2020 Masterplan amid rising healthcare expenditure.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head O of the Estimates be reduced by $100".

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: We are now just two years away from the year 2020, and I would like to begin by asking the Ministry of Health (MOH) to give an update on the progress of the Healthcare 2020 Masterplan.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The Budget Statement which was delivered last week, gave us a stark reminder that although Singapore may be one of the healthiest nations in the world with a healthcare system that is admired by many, and Singaporeans may be amongst the longest living, but with our ageing population and a growing chronic disease burden, healthcare expenditure is rising, and it is rising very quickly.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The MOH's operating Budget has risen from $5.87 billion in financial year (FY) 2014 to almost $9 billion for FY2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The first was moving beyond healthcare to health; the second, moving beyond the hospital to the community; and third, moving beyond quality to value.

sections.label: Public rental housing readmission risk
sections.summary: A Singapore study found public rental housing independently associated with higher hospital re-admission risk and frequent admission and Emergency Department use.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Closer to home, as Member Dr Tan Wu Meng had alluded to in an earlier speech, a study in Singapore also noted that if you use public rental housing as a measure of socioeconomic status, then this, in itself, is independently associated with increased hospital re-admission risk, and being a frequent hospital admitter and also an Emergency Department user.

sections.label: Education and health screening survey
sections.summary: A year-long survey of almost 3,000 residents found those with higher educational levels less likely to smoke and more likely to go for health screening.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: This survey reached out to almost 3,000 residents and was conducted over a period of about a year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: It was a very good study but, I think, one repeated observation that I got was that residents who had higher educational levels were less likely to smoke and they were more likely to go for health screening, such as colonoscopy for colon cancer, mammography for breast cancer and pap smears for cervical cancer.

sections.label: Social inequality and health inequity
sections.summary: The speaker says social inequality is an important determinant of health inequity and calls for focus on social mobility and reducing inequities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: It was just that those from higher educational levels actually made that extra effort to go ahead with the screening.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Thus, it is clear that an important determinant of health inequity is also social inequality, and as we strive to be a healthier country, we should never lose focus on enhancing social mobility and reducing social inequities.

sections.label: Agency for Care Effectiveness role
sections.summary: Budget 2018 acknowledges rising healthcare spending, institutions were reorganised from six clusters to three, and ACE is called to play a bigger role.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Budget 2018 is frank and upfront about the financial pressures that our nation is likely to face over the next decade, and healthcare spending is one of the areas that will see the greatest increase in public spending.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Our healthcare institutions were recently reorganised from six clusters to three.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I have also previously asked for a body to be set up to evaluate not only the efficacy, but also the value of various medical and health-related interventions, whether diagnostic or therapeutic.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I am glad that we now have the Agency for Care Effectiveness (ACE), and I call for ACE to play a bigger role in our quest for value and clarity in our healthcare spending.

sections.label: ILTC investment and smart technology
sections.summary: The speaker asks for updates on ILTC investments, whether infrastructure upgrading meets Healthcare 2020 targets, and how smart technology will be integrated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Will the Minister share updates on the investments for ILTC?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Will the upgrading and expansion of our current infrastructure be enough to meet the targets set in the Healthcare 2020 Master Plan?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In addition, how will the Ministry be integrating "smart" technology into our healthcare infrastructure to boost care delivery standards and efficiency, and to reduce costs?

sections.label: Clinical genetic testing standards timeline
sections.summary: MOH said clinical genetic testing standards would be a code of practice by late 2017 and enforceable in late 2018, and HITF recommended publishing medical fee benchmarks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In March last year, MOH announced that the standards for the provision of clinical genetic testing were being drafted and would be ready as a code of practice by late 2017 before becoming enforceable in late 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Is the Ministry still on track with this timeline?

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: Dr Chia Shi-Lu, please take both cuts together.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: This is important as close to two-thirds of Singaporeans currently have an integrated health insurance plan.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: In its report that was released in 2016, HITF had recommended a few things, the first being the publication of medical fee benchmarks to help raise price transparency so that patients can make more informed choices.

sections.label: HITF co-payment and Integrated Shield Plans
sections.summary: HITF noted private insurance features giving 100% coverage without co-payment may encourage over consumption and over servicing, and six Integrated Shield Plans appealed for compulsory co-payments.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: The second recommendation was that HITF noted in its report that there were private insurance features and riders that "provide policyholders with 100% coverage without any co-payment", and they expressed their concern that the absence of co-payment may encourage both over consumption and over servicing in regard to medical care.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: And I note from the report in today's papers that the six Integrated Shield Plans (IP) insurance have appealed to MOH to make co-payments compulsory.

sections.label: CDMP coverage of chronic conditions
sections.summary: CDMP lets patients with chronic conditions use MediSave and reduce out-of-pocket expenses, but currently covers only rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: CDMP is meant to allow patients with chronic conditions to use MediSave and reduce out of pocket expenses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: However, it currently covers only two auto-immune conditions, that is, rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

sections.label: HPV vaccination among Singapore women
sections.summary: The HPV vaccine can prevent most cervical cancers, but only about one quarter of Singapore women are vaccinated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The HPV vaccine, for instance, can prevent most cervical cancers, saving lives and cost, but only about one quarter of Singapore women are vaccinated.

sections.label: MSF Client Assessment Form for caregivers
sections.summary: From 1 April 2018, MSF and MOH will use MSF's Client Assessment Form to assess mentally disabled persons' ADL support needs and caregivers' eligibility for FDW levy concession or grant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Senior Parliamentary Secretary Assoc Prof Muhd Faishal Ibrahim announced in this House just about two hours ago that from 1 April 2018 onwards, the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) and MOH have agreed to use an additional yardstick, in the form of MSF's Client Assessment Form, to evaluate the level of support a mentally disabled person requires to perform Activities of Daily Living (ADL).

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: This, in turn, will determine the eligibility of caregivers of mentally disabled persons to qualify for a foreign domestic worker (FDW) levy concession of $60 per month or a grant of $120 per month.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: MSF estimated that about 1,000 caregivers will benefit from the enhancing of the system.

sections.label: AIC and GP mental health programmes
sections.summary: By 2021, AIC will manage 50 community outreach teams and MOH's Mental Health GP Partnership Programme will partner 180 GP clinics.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: By 2021, the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) will manage 50 community outreach teams to raise awareness of mental health, identify those at risk and conduct preventive care programmes.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Also, by 2021, the Mental Health General Practitioner (GP) Partnership Programme run by MOH will partner 180 GP clinics to manage patients with mental health issues.

sections.label: Ageing population mental health
sections.summary: With more seniors in an ageing population, more will face mental health issues.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Chairman, with an increase in our ageing population, more seniors will be facing mental health issues.

sections.label: Access to senior mental health services
sections.summary: It asks how the Ministry makes mental health services more accessible to seniors and how caregivers and families can be better supported.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: How is the Ministry making mental health services more accessible to support these seniors with such conditions?

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Also, how can their caregivers and their family members be better supported?

sections.label: Korean Silver Town model
sections.summary: The Korean Silver Town model is worth a closer look as a roughly S$10 billion industry that evolved over decades.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, the Korean Silver Town model is worth a closer look since it is a roughly S$10 billion industry and it has had a long runway in Korea, evolving over the decades.

sections.label: Nursing home price affordability
sections.summary: It asks how the Ministry ensures nursing home prices are kept affordable.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: How does the Ministry ensure that nursing home prices are kept at an affordable price?

sections.label: Low-income women caregivers pool
sections.summary: Emotions and human interactions remain the backbone of caregiving, and about 25,000 low-income women and single mothers represent a third of Singapore's unemployed.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: The emotions and human interactions remain the backbone of caregiving.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: There is a pool of low-income women and single mothers, estimated to be 25,000, representing a third of Singapore's unemployed population.

sections.label: Employment for women in eldercare
sections.summary: It proposes changing employment provision to lift families out of poverty, citing Daughters of Tomorrow's eldercare training and suggesting MOH work with VWOs under the Community Network for Seniors.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: But beyond themselves, what we can potentially change here is the provision of employment and lifting their families out of poverty in a dignified way.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: There are VWOs like Daughters of Tomorrow (DOT) which began in 2017 to provide professional training skills for these women in eldercare services.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: They have successfully placed them in the eldercare sector or as freelance caregivers.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: With the strong push for Community Network for Seniors (CNS), MOH can assist by working with these VWOs to identify a pool of known resources and accelerate the training of the individuals through funding or fill the gaps in resource deployment.

sections.label: SMF senior subsidies
sections.summary: SMF provides seniors subsidies for assistive devices, homecare items or transport.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Today, SMF provides the seniors with subsidies for assistive devices and homecare items or transport.

sections.label: Digital eldercare R&D funding
sections.summary: The speaker asks for an update on fund utilisation and success cases for digital eldercare R&D and startups.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: It would, therefore, be most ideal if Singapore can leverage our existing competencies in research and development (R&D) to develop digital eldercare solutions for ourselves.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: I understand that MOH had introduced a funding scheme to encourage innovations to solve elderly-related challenges.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Therefore, I would like to ask for an update on the utilisation of funds to support R&D efforts and startups looking into digital eldercare solutions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Could the Government share some of the success cases so far?

sections.label: Silver industry guidelines count
sections.summary: Singapore currently has only two silver industry guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Currently, there are only two silver industry guidelines in Singapore.

sections.label: Elderly-friendliness office proposal
sections.summary: The speaker asks if the Ministry will consider an office to research, set standards and audit projects for elderly-friendliness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: We are already doing so much to get ourselves ready for an ageing population, I believe we should look into this area.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Therefore, I would like to ask if the Ministry will consider setting up an office that does research, set standards and audit public and private projects to ensure elderly-friendliness.

sections.label: SCN well-being and staffing
sections.summary: The speaker asks if MOH will adopt physical, mental and social well-being in SCN and how many staff will manage it.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: Will MOH adopt the concept of physical, mental and social well-being for the seniors in the Senior Cluster Network (SCN) so that these seniors can stay active and healthy through having daily balanced nutrition, physical activity and cognitive stimulation?

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: How many administrative staff and medical staff will be deployed to manage the present SCN?

sections.label: SCN centres and SACs
sections.summary: The speaker asks if MOH will provide SCN centres in more constituencies and SACs for 1- to 2-room flat precincts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: Will MOH be planning to provide SCN centres in more constituencies?

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: Will MOH consider setting up SACs for every cluster precinct of 1- to 2-room flats as surveys have found that seniors who live in this type of housing tend to be more frail?

sections.label: Nurse and healthcare aides team
sections.summary: A team of one nurse and five foreign healthcare aides, with SAC staff and volunteers, can look after a few hundred residents.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: A team of one nurse and five foreign healthcare aides, together with SAC staff and grassroots volunteers, can look after a few hundred residents.

sections.label: SCN and AIC integration
sections.summary: The SCN-AIC integration aims to streamline services for seniors, raising questions on jobs, skillsets, employee terms and integration.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The initiative to integrate the SCN and AIC will surely help to streamline and consolidate the services provided by the respective agencies to better support seniors in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: However, will there be current jobs at risk or new jobs created with this integration effort?

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: What new skillsets are required to better prepare integrated AIC staff to better manage both social and health issues so that there can be cross-training and learning opportunities?

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Employees of SCN moving over to AIC must be engaged early and transited with no less favourable terms and conditions as a package.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: There must be efforts to integrate the employees of AIC and those from SCN for better team coordination and morale to serve the seniors better.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Today, Singaporeans are living longer and our Health Adjusted Life Expectancy, which estimates the number of years a person is expected to live in good health, remains one of the best in the world, at 72 years for males and 75 for females.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: About three in four Singapore residents aged 65 and above are affected by diabetes, high cholesterol or hypertension or a combination of these three.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: If nothing is done, diabetes, for example, is projected to affect more than one million Singaporeans by 2050.

sections.label: Hospital and nursing home beds
sections.summary: Since 2011, 1,700 acute hospital beds, 1,200 community hospital beds and 5,300 nursing home beds were added.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Since 2011, we have added 1,700 acute hospital beds, 1,200 community hospital beds, and 5,300 nursing home beds.

sections.label: National healthcare expenditure increase
sections.summary: NHE rose over 60% in five years, from $10.9 billion in 2010 to $18.9 billion in 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: NHE has increased by more than 60% in five years, from $10.9 billion in 2010 to $18.9 billion in 2015.

sections.label: Fee Benchmarks Committee
sections.summary: A multi-pronged approach to healthcare costs included setting up the Fee Benchmarks Committee earlier this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We adopted a multi-pronged approach to manage healthcare costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We set up the Fee Benchmarks Committee earlier this year to provide a reference to guide doctors in setting reasonable fees and to help patients to make informed choices on their care options.

sections.label: Co-payment for IP riders
sections.summary: MOH issued new requirements to IP insurers, requiring co-payment features in all new rider policies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: This will encourage unnecessary treatment, leading to rising healthcare costs not only for those with such riders but for all of us.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Therefore, MOH has been working with the insurance industry and we have issued a set of new requirements to IP insurers which will be applied to all new rider policies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We will require them to have co-payment features going forward.

sections.label: Public healthcare reclustering completed
sections.summary: The reclustering of the public healthcare system into three integrated clusters has been successfully completed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Last year, I announced plans to reorganise the public healthcare system into three integrated clusters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: I am pleased to report that the reclustering exercise has been successfully completed.

sections.label: MOH Office of Healthcare Transformation
sections.summary: The MOH Office of Healthcare Transformation was set up to identify and experiment with bold innovations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: In addition to progressive improvements, we also need to explore game-changing ideas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: That is why we have set up the MOH Office of Healthcare Transformation (MOHT), to identify and experiment with bold innovations.

sections.label: Kent Ridge campus master planning
sections.summary: A master planning study will plan ahead and reimagine rejuvenating the future Kent Ridge campus, including the main NUH hospital building.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: In 2013, we opened the NUH Medical Centre, and we will be opening the National University Centre for Oral Health next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: The master planning study presents us with the opportunity to plan ahead and reimagine how the future Kent Ridge campus, including the main NUH hospital building, which is more than 30 years old, can be rejuvenated to support current and future models of care.

sections.label: Health coach and Better Health
sections.summary: Mr Mohamed Irfan co-started a health programme as health coach, believing an active community can motivate healthy lifestyles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Last year, he co-started a health programme, where he was the health coach.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Mr Mohamed Irfan believes an active community can motivate individuals to sustain a healthy lifestyle.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I believe that by working together, each of us playing our part, we can bring about Better Health, Better Care and a Better Life for all Singaporeans.

sections.label: Additional productivity funding for HPF
sections.summary: Another $80 million in productivity funding will be added to HPF over the next three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: To encourage more to participate and seize opportunities to improve productivity, we will add another $80 million in productivity funding to HPF over the next three years to support our institutions and healthcare workers.

sections.label: Kronikare AI wound analysis app
sections.summary: Startup Kronikare developed a smartphone application using AI to analyse wounds and detect early infection stages within seconds.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: For example, a local startup, Kronikare, developed a smartphone application using AI to analyse wounds.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: It can do so within seconds to detect early stages of infection, a task that previously required two or more nurses up to 30 minutes to perform.

sections.label: Higher deductible for aged 81
sections.summary: The Committee recommended a higher deductible for those aged 81 and above to reduce their premiums.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: On balance, the Committee recommended a higher deductible for those aged 81 and above to reduce their premiums.

sections.label: Elderly Government subsidies per year
sections.summary: An elderly Singaporean aged 65 and above obtains more than six times the Government subsidies per year compared to those below 65.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: On average, an elderly Singaporean aged 65 and above obtains more than six times the amount of Government subsidies per year, compared to younger Singaporeans below 65.

sections.label: MOH Appropriate Care Guidelines
sections.summary: Since May 2017, MOH has issued Appropriate Care Guidelines on medical treatment and drugs to guide healthcare providers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Since May 2017, MOH has issued Appropriate Care Guidelines on medical treatment and drugs to guide healthcare providers making decisions that are based on clinical and cost effectiveness.

sections.label: Fees Benchmarks Advisory Committee
sections.summary: In January this year, MOH set up a Fees Benchmarks Advisory Committee to recommend and develop fee benchmarks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: In January this year, MOH set up a Fees Benchmarks Advisory Committee to recommend and develop fee benchmarks for medical procedures and services.

sections.label: Full rider policyholders and bills
sections.summary: About 29% of Singapore Residents have full riders, and in 2016 their average medical bill was about 60% higher.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Currently, about 29% of Singapore Residents have these full riders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: In 2016, the average medical bill size for full rider policyholders was about 60% higher than the average bill size for those without riders, even though rider policyholders are younger and generally in better health.

sections.label: New IP rider co-payment
sections.summary: New IP riders must incorporate co-payment of 5% or more.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: New IP riders must incorporate co-payment of 5% or more.

sections.label: Insurer rider plans transition
sections.summary: Insurers may keep selling existing rider plans but must tell new policyholders they transit to new co-payment riders from 1 April 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: In the meantime, insurers can continue selling their existing rider plans but must inform new policyholders that they will transit to the new riders with co-payment from 1 April 2021.

sections.label: Co-payment on inpatient bills
sections.summary: At 5% co-payment, half of 2016 inpatient bills would have a co-payment amount of $100 or less.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: At 5% co-payment, half of the inpatient bills in 2016 would have a co-payment amount of $100 or less.

sections.label: Diabetes scope covers pre-diabetes
sections.summary: The scope of diabetes will be extended to cover pre-diabetes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: First, we will extend the scope of diabetes to cover pre-diabetes.

sections.label: CDMP list adds heart disease
sections.summary: The list of CDMP conditions will be expanded to cover ischaemic heart disease, bringing total covered conditions to 20.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Second, we will expand the list of CDMP conditions to cover ischaemic heart disease (IHD), bringing the total number of covered conditions to 20.

sections.label: MediSave400 withdrawal limit raised
sections.summary: The withdrawal limit for the MediSave400 scheme will be raised by 25%, from $400 to $500 per year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: In addition, we will raise the withdrawal limit for MediSave400 scheme by 25%, from $400 per year to $500 per year.

sections.label: Attracting locals to ILTC jobs
sections.summary: With ILTC expansion, 80% to 90% of jobs are filled by foreigners as Singaporeans are less inclined to join due to prestige, progression and remuneration.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
sentences.text: With the expansion of the ILTC sector, how can we better attract locals for the jobs when, at present, 80% to 90% of these jobs are filled by foreigners?

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
sentences.text: Singaporean healthcare professionals are less inclined to join the ILTC sector due to the perceived prestige, progression as well as the varying remuneration offered, which is less favourable than that provided by public healthcare institutions.

sections.label: ILTC skills framework and association
sections.summary: The speaker urges MOH to implement a national skills framework for ILTC jobs, pay by skills, and help form an ILTC association.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
sentences.text: The union can act as a conduit to refer more local workers into this sector for upskilling and reskilling.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
sentences.text: I urge MOH to implement a national skills framework for ILTC sector jobs and remunerate based on the skills and job worth.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
sentences.text: Lastly, I would again urge MOH to act as a catalyst to help navigate the formation of an association for the ILTC sector so that the national skills framework and all relevant best practices can be uniformly adopted by the players in this sector which will be a win-win-win for all, that is, the organisations, staff and patients at the heart.

sections.label: Beneficiaries of healthcare change
sections.summary: The passage lists four beneficiaries: patients, doctors, allied healthcare workers, and the next generation of Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: First of all, the patients who will receive quicker and more targeted care; second, the doctors' workload will be alleviated; the third to benefit are the allied healthcare workers themselves as they can look forward to career opportunities; and fourth to benefit would be the next generation of Singaporeans who will have the option of entering meaningful healthcare-related vocations.

sections.label: Abortions and life-births figures
sections.summary: MOH figures show abortions fell nearly 40% to 7,217 in 2017, against 39,605 life-births, meaning at least 15% of pregnancies were terminated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: According to figures by MOH, the number of abortions between 2007 and 2017 has dropped nearly 40% to 7,217 last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: In the same time period in 2017, there was 39,605 life-births in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Therefore, it is a proportion that means at least 15% of pregnancies were terminated.

sections.label: Survival at 22 weeks gestation
sections.summary: In 1995 practically no children born at 22 weeks gestation survived, while in 2008, 21% survived.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: In 1995, practically no children survived when born at 22 weeks of gestation age, while in 2008, 21% survived.

sections.label: Gestational diabetes in Singapore
sections.summary: One in five pregnancies in Singapore are affected by gestational diabetes, and two in three such mothers later develop diabetes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: In Singapore, one in five pregnancies are affected by gestational diabetes and two in three mothers who have gestational diabetes go on to develop diabetes later in life.

sections.label: Seniors aged 65 and above
sections.summary: By 2030 seniors aged 65 and above will almost double to over 900,000, with the largest increase between 2020 and 2025.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: By 2030, the number of seniors aged 65 and above will almost double to over 900,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The largest increase will occur between 2020 and 2025, with about 179,000 Baby Boomers entering 65 years and above.

sections.label: C2H programme expansion
sections.summary: Over 2,500 seniors have benefited from C2H, which will expand from 11 to four more sites in Beach Road, Chai Chee, Chin Swee and Lengkok Bahru.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To date, over 2,500 seniors have benefited from the C2H programme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This year, we will expand the programme from the current 11 to another four sites in the Beach Road, Chai Chee, Chin Swee and Lengkok Bahru areas, so that more seniors can benefit.

sections.label: SMF subsidies top-up
sections.summary: Another $100 million will be topped up over the next five years to extend SMF subsidies to benefit more seniors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As earlier announced at Budget, we will top up another $100 million over the next five years to further extend SMF subsidies to benefit more seniors.

sections.label: CNS island-wide expansion
sections.summary: CNS will be expanded island-wide by 2020, as announced at Budget 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As announced at Budget 2018, we will be expanding CNS island-wide by 2020.

sections.label: Community nursing teams growth
sections.summary: Eight community nursing teams reached over 10,000 patients, and the pool of about 130 community nurses is hoped to increase to 200 by end 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In the past year, they have piloted eight geographically-based community nursing teams, to anchor population health and care for residents and, in fact, these teams have actually reached out to more than 10,000 patients.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Our nurses are familiar with the services in hospitals and the community and can bridge patient care needs across both settings.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We currently have a pool of about 130 community nurses from our three clusters providing care for residents with different needs across care settings, and we hope to increase this to 200 by end 2019.

sections.label: Frontline staff mental health training
sections.summary: Over 6,000 frontline staff from Government agencies and community partners have been trained to identify and respond to persons with mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Over 6,000 frontline staff from various Government agencies and community partners have been trained to identify and respond to persons with mental health conditions.

sections.label: Polyclinic mental health services
sections.summary: Mental health and dementia services have been rolled out in eight polyclinics, on track for one in two polyclinics to have mental health clinics by 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In the area of Primary Care, we have rolled out a combination of mental health and dementia services in eight polyclinics.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are on track to meeting our target for one in two polyclinics to implement mental health clinics by 2021.

sections.label: Dementia friendly communities expansion
sections.summary: Six dementia friendly communities are established, with plans to expand to 15 in about three years, reaching over 23,000 people.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As mentioned by Miss Cheng Li Hui, we have established six dementia friendly communities (DFCs) to create a culture of awareness of dementia and inclusivity so that persons with dementia and their families feel at home and supported in the community.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We plan to expand to 15 DFCs in the next three years or so.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To date, we have reached out to over 23,000 people to support persons with dementia and their caregivers and will continue to do more.

sections.label: Medical and nursing intake growth
sections.summary: Local medical intake rose from 350 to 480 students in five years, and nursing intake grew 30% from 1,500 in 2012 to around 2,000 in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Our local medical intake has grown from 350 to 480 students over the past five years, and we are on track to reach our target of 500 in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The total nursing intake has also increased by 30% from 1,500 in 2012 to around 2,000 students in 2017.

sections.label: Recruitment of Singaporeans in aged care
sections.summary: Recruitment efforts placed more than 1,000 Singaporeans with some 29 aged care service providers in the community.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In going beyond hospital to community, we have also accelerated recruitment efforts over the past year to place more than 1,000 Singaporeans with some 29 aged care service providers in the community.

sections.label: Part-time study for nurses
sections.summary: A new programme lets nurses study part-time while working, earning a graduate certificate per module that stacks up towards a graduate diploma.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The new programme will allow nurses greater flexibility in pursuing part-time study while continuing to work.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: They can obtain a graduate certificate upon completion of each module that will "stack up" towards a graduate diploma.

sections.label: Skills recognition for nurses
sections.summary: MOH and the Singapore Nursing Board will engage nursing leadership to look into stronger skills recognition for nurses trained by accredited healthcare institutions, for portability across the sector.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: MOH, together with the Singapore Nursing Board, will engage the nursing leadership to look into a stronger system of skills recognition so that nurses who are trained by any accredited healthcare institution, can have their skills recognised for portability across the healthcare sector.

sections.label: Collaborative prescribing by nurses and pharmacists
sections.summary: Rules will be revised with safeguards to allow experienced public healthcare nurses and pharmacists to legally prescribe medicines under doctors' supervision.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Moving forward, we will revise our rules and put in safeguards to allow experienced and qualified nurses and pharmacists in the public healthcare sector to legally prescribe medicines through collaborative prescribing, under the supervision of doctors, so as to increase patients' access to quality care.

sections.label: ITE Work-Learn Rehabilitation Care Diploma
sections.summary: ITE will roll out a new Work-Learn Technical Diploma in Rehabilitation Care in April 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As a further boost to their training and development, the Institute of Technical Education (ITE) will be rolling out a new Work-Learn Technical Diploma in Rehabilitation Care in April 2018.

sections.label: Foetal viability and MOH care commitment
sections.summary: MOH notes low foetal viability below 24 weeks, will monitor the issue, and affirms commitment to communities of care for seniors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Medical experts from our healthcare institutions note that foetal viability below 24 weeks remains low, while neurodevelopmental disabilities are very high among premature babies who survive.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Only 1% of all abortions in 2017 were performed between 22 and 24 gestational weeks, of which, more than half of these were due to foetal anomalies and other medical reasons.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: MOH will continue to monitor and review this issue as new evidence emerges.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Chairman, to conclude, let me affirm MOH's commitment to build communities of care for seniors across Singapore so that they benefit from preventive health and affordable, quality healthcare that is person-centric.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Together with a capable workforce, we can meet the needs of our ageing population in a sustainable way, enabling our seniors to age gracefully in place and with peace of mind.

sections.label: War on Diabetes in Singapore
sections.summary: The Minister for Health declared War on Diabetes in 2016 and one in three Singaporeans has a lifetime diabetes risk.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen Show Mao (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In 2016, the Minister for Health declared War on Diabetes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen Show Mao (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In 2017, the Prime Minister spoke of diabetes as one of the three key long-term issues for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen Show Mao (Aljunied)
sentences.text: One in three Singaporeans has a lifetime risk of developing diabetes with serious and costly consequences.

sections.label: Repeal of PHMCA
sections.summary: MOH has previously indicated its intention to repeal the Private Hospitals Medical Clinics Act enacted in 1980.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: MOH has previously indicated its intention to repeal the Private Hospitals Medical Clinics Act (PHMCA) enacted in 1980.

sections.label: Feedback on Healthcare Services Bill
sections.summary: MOH sought public feedback on the draft Healthcare Services Bill earlier this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: MOH has sought public feedback on the draft Healthcare Services Bill earlier this year.

sections.label: Tobacco excise duty and measures
sections.summary: The 10% excise duty increase on tobacco products may reduce cigarette demand, but other measures such as public education must continue.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: The recently announced 10% increase in excise duty on all tobacco products may help to reduce the demand for cigarettes but we must also continue with other measures, such as public education, to highlight the negative effects of smoking and perhaps also increasing the number of smoke-free zones.

sections.label: Tobacco use reduction measures
sections.summary: MOH is asked what other measures it is taking or considering to reduce tobacco use and the impact of second- and third-hand smoke.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: Beyond raising the minimum legal age for smoking and purchase of tobacco to 21 years by the year 2021, what other measures is MOH taking or considering to reduce tobacco use in our population?

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: In addition, what measures does the Ministry have to reduce the impact of second- and third-hand smoke?

sections.label: New polyclinic developments
sections.summary: Ongoing polyclinic developments are scheduled by 2020, with plans for 30-32 polyclinics by 2030 and two new ones by 2023.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In addition to our newly opened polyclinics in Punggol and Pioneer, there are ongoing polyclinic developments in Eunos, Kallang, Sembawang and Bukit Panjang scheduled to open by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The Minister has announced plans to develop a further six to eight new polyclinics which will enlarge our network to 30-32 polyclinics by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I am pleased to inform Members that two of the new polyclinics are expected to be operational by 2023 and will be developed in the northern region in Nee Soon Central, and the eastern region in Tampines North.

sections.label: PCN scheme commencement
sections.summary: The PCN scheme commenced in January this year with 10 PCNs involving more than 300 GP clinics.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The PCN scheme commenced in January this year with 10 PCNs on board, involving more than 300 GP clinics.

sections.label: Home and day care capacity
sections.summary: By 2020, home care capacity will rise from 8,000 to 10,000 places and day care from 5,000 to 6,200 places.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: By 2020, home care capacity will increase from the current 8,000 places to 10,000 places, while day care capacity will increase from the current 5,000 to 6,200 places.

sections.label: Diabetic foot amputation review
sections.summary: MOH will set up a workgroup to review diabetic foot services, guidelines and training to decrease lifetime amputation risk for diabetic patients.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In 2015, about 180 diabetes-related major LEAs were performed for every 100,000 adult Singaporeans with diabetes, compared to the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) average of 60.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: MOH will be setting up a workgroup to review the national organisation of diabetic foot services, make recommendations on national care guidelines, and review the roles and training needs of healthcare professionals involved in diabetic foot care to decrease the lifetime risk of amputation for diabetic patients.

sections.label: NHG diabetes intervention pilot
sections.summary: NHG launched a Diabetes Community Intervention Programme pilot with Toa Payoh Polyclinic to engage patients with or at risk of diabetes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For example, in the Central region, the National Healthcare Group (NHG) has launched a Diabetes Community Intervention Programme (CIP) pilot with Toa Payoh Polyclinic to engage patients with, or at risk of, diabetes to take ownership of their well-being.

sections.label: New Healthcare Services Bill
sections.summary: MOH is enacting a Healthcare Services Bill to replace the PHMCA, adopting modular services-based licensing for providers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As announced earlier, MOH is enacting a new Healthcare Services Bill to replace the current PHMCA this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The Bill will adopt a modular services-based licensing system to allow providers more flexibility in holding licences for any combination of healthcare services provided.

sections.label: Early Contribution Incentive and LEAP
sections.summary: $20 million under the Early Contribution Incentive helps licensees upgrade IT systems for NEHR; MOH rolls out LEAP regulatory sandbox.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For example, $20 million under the Early Contribution Incentive scheme is available to help licensees defray the cost of upgrading their IT systems to contribute data to NEHR by June 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To address this, MOH will be rolling out the Licence Experimentation and Adaptation Programme (LEAP), which is a regulatory sandbox that will allow new services to be piloted in a controlled environment.

sections.label: Sandbox pilot areas
sections.summary: The sandbox will focus on piloting models in telemedicine, precision medicine and models of care supporting ageing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For a start, the sandbox will focus on piloting models in three areas, namely, telemedicine, precision medicine and models of care that support ageing.

sections.label: Refining standards from feedback
sections.summary: Feedback will be considered when refining the standards, targeted to be rolled out in the second quarter of 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The feedback provided will be taken into consideration when refining the standards, which are targeted to be rolled out in the second quarter of 2018.

sections.label: National Strategic Action Plan on AMR
sections.summary: MOH, AVA, NEA and PUB jointly developed Singapore's National Strategic Action Plan on AMR, launched in November last year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: MOH, the Agri-Food and Veterinary Authority (AVA), the National Environment Agency (NEA) and the Public Utilities Board (PUB) had jointly developed Singapore’s National Strategic Action Plan on AMR, which was launched in November last year to chart out how agencies will work together to detect and arrest AMR through increased surveillance, education, management, research and international cooperation.

sections.label: Future-ready healthcare system
sections.summary: The Ministry will continue to build capabilities and increase capacity to ensure a future-ready healthcare system.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, my Ministry will continue to build capabilities and increase capacity in the future to ensure that we have a future-ready healthcare system.

sections.label: Elderly health handouts review
sections.summary: The Ministry is asked to review handouts for the elderly and caregivers, using big fonts, graphics and different languages on managing health conditions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: Will the Ministry review its handouts and information sheets for the elderly and their caregivers, using big fonts and graphics, where possible, on how to better manage their varied health conditions?

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: Can the information be printed in different languages to explain, for example, what type of exercises and diets are best suited for a diabetic patient, or what food or vegetables are good for lowering cholesterol levels?

sections.label: Promoting healthy living, less sugar
sections.summary: The member asks how the Ministry is furthering efforts to promote healthy living through lowered consumption of sugar or sugar-sweetened beverages.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Still, changing habits and combatting diabetes is a long journey.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Hence, I would like to ask the Ministry how it is furthering efforts to promote healthy living through lowered consumption of sugar or sugar-sweetened beverages.

sections.label: Stalls under the programme
sections.summary: More than 3,000 coffee shop and hawker centre stalls, and over 2,000 F&B places, are under this programme.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: More than 3,000 stalls in coffee shops and hawker centres, as well as over 2,000 food and beverage (F&B) places are under this programme.

sections.label: Partners and healthier products
sections.summary: As of December 2017, 14 partners offer 37 healthier products supplied to over 2,000 F&B stalls.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: As of December 2017, we now have 14 partners offering 37 healthier products, supplied to over 2,000 F&B stalls.

sections.label: Sugar intake reduction potential
sections.summary: Such food products contribute about 90% of total sugar intake and could reduce sugar in Singaporeans' diet by 25% by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Such food products contribute to about 90% of total sugar intake in our diet.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: This is a potential game changer, benefiting Singaporean families and could contribute to reducing sugar in Singaporeans’ diet by 25% by 2020.

sections.label: Lower sugar beverage market share
sections.summary: The market share of lower sugar beverages marked with the HCS symbol grew from 30% in 2012 to 43% in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: The market share of lower sugar beverages marked with the HCS symbol has grown from 30% in 2012 to 43% in 2017.

sections.label: Seniors' Health Curriculum attendance
sections.summary: Over 24,000 seniors attended the Seniors' Health Curriculum workshops, and over 3,400 senior Singaporeans benefited from health coaching sessions as of December 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Over 24,000 seniors have attended the Seniors' Health Curriculum, a series of workshops to improve seniors’ physical, mental and functional health.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: As of December 2017, over 3,400 senior Singaporeans have benefited from these health coaching sessions.

sections.label: National diabetes curriculum framework
sections.summary: A national curriculum will be developed to equip persons with diabetes with knowledge and life skills to manage their condition.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Under the Framework, we will develop a national curriculum to equip persons with diabetes with knowledge and life skills to manage their condition.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: We will take on the good suggestions by Ms Joan Pereira and will review the information on diabetes management and diet of our elderly patients and their caregivers.

sections.label: Mosque health programme with MUIS
sections.summary: HPB worked with MUIS to create the Jaga Kesihatan, Jaga Ummah programme, and 15 mosques have joined the health initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: We worked with the Islamic Religious Council of Singapore (MUIS) and, as a result, the Jaga Kesihatan, Jaga Ummah (Taking Care of Health, Taking Care of the Community) programme was born, whereby HPB collaborates with mosques to organise healthy lifestyle activities.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: And another outcome is that 15 mosques have now joined this health initiative.

sections.label: Health outreach to Indian community
sections.summary: Health outreach to the Indian community will be intensified through places of worship, F&B outlets and media, and by partnering Sikh and Indian temples.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: One, we will intensify health outreach to the Indian community through places of worship, Indian F&B outlets and Indian media to promote healthy eating, regular physical activity and regular screening and follow-up.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Two, we are partnering Sikh and Indian temples to bring health programmes, such as screening, exercise and healthy cooking programmes.

sections.label: Tobacco-free lifestyle campaign
sections.summary: A new public education campaign will be launched this year to encourage Singaporeans to live a tobacco-free lifestyle.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Dr Chia Shi Lu asked what other measures we are considering to reduce tobacco use in our population.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: This year, we will be launching a new public education campaign to encourage Singaporeans to live a tobacco-free lifestyle.

sections.label: Standardised packaging public consultation
sections.summary: Singapore announced a public consultation on a proposal for standardised packaging with enlarged graphic public health warnings.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Singapore recently announced a public consultation to gather detailed views on a proposal for the introduction of standardised packaging, together with enlarged graphic public health warnings.

sections.label: Nurse salaries and bonus
sections.summary: Nurses' salaries were reviewed twice in 2014 and 2015, rising 3% to 10% yearly, and a special year-end nurse bonus was introduced.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Well, for nurses, under the National Nursing Taskforce, we have reviewed the salaries of nurses in 2014 and 2015, twice, between 3% and 10% increase each year and we introduced a special nurse payment bonus at the end of the year.

sections.label: Local training pipeline of 500
sections.summary: A local training pipeline of 500 will be in place by this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have noted, we will have a local training pipeline of 500 by this year.

sections.label: Early breast cancer detection outcomes
sections.summary: Early stage breast cancer diagnosed rose from 70.9% in 2003-2007 to 72.4% in 2012-2016, and five-year survival rose from 66% to 71%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: First of all, indeed, as Dr Lily Neo had said, early detection facilitates prompt treatment and, in fact, it is key to improving the health outcomes of women diagnosed with breast cancer.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I am pleased to say that the percentage of early stage breast cancer diagnosed has actually increased from 70.9% in the period 2003 to 2007, to 72.4% in the period from 2012 to 2016.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In addition, there was a significant increase in a five-year observed survival of breast cancer patients from 66% in the period 2003 to 2007, to 71% in 2012 to 2016.

sections.label: Gestational diabetes screening and care guide
sections.summary: Routine GDM screening for public hospital pregnant women began March last year, over 12,000 were screened, and a care guide will be issued this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For gestational diabetes (GDM), MOH announced last year that we will undertake routine screening and make it available for all pregnant women under the care of the public hospitals with maternity services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Since the introduction of this policy in March last year, over 12,000 pregnant women have been screened at our three public healthcare institutions – KK Women’s and Children’s Hospital (KKH), SGH and NUH.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: About one in five pregnant women screened over the past year was found to have GDM.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, MOH has been reviewing relevant considerations pertaining to the management of GDM and longer-term post-delivery management.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will be issuing an appropriate care guide later this year to better support primary care doctors who are involved in the care of women with GDM post-delivery.

sections.label: From healthier to healthy choice
sections.summary: A suggestion was made to move from just healthier choice to actually healthy choice, since some healthier choice items may not be healthy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The first suggestion is that we move from just healthier choice to actually healthy choice, because some things that are labelled "healthier choice" may not, in fact, be healthy.

sections.label: Studying UK and France food labels
sections.summary: Other measures are being considered, including studying the UK's traffic light system and France's Nutri-score.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my speech just now, we are considering other measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: We are studying what the UK is doing with regard to its "traffic light system" for food and drinks, as well as France's Nutri-score.

sections.label: Taxes and smoking prevalence
sections.summary: Taxes work with other control measures, and smoking prevalence fell from 23% in 1977 to around 13% recently, though pinpointing tax increases' contribution is difficult.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Taxes work in conjunction with our other control measures and if Members look at how we have reduced the smoking prevalence rate from the high of 23% in 1977 to around roughly 13% in recent years, it shows the extent of our success.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: It is, of course, very difficult to pinpoint specific measures, like how much have tax increases contributed to reducing this prevalence rate.
